english: Be well. What is that? I do not know that word. The fathers of your daughters and of my sons(?). Now you are kin to me. Do you (pl.) drive cows by day? They drive them; I do not drive them. Now who gives you milk(ing)? Your words are new to me.
uncertain: dʰugh₂trṓm toy moy suHnéwes ph₂téres: the syntax of the kinship explanation is unclear to me blind (GEN.PL daughters + NOM.PL sons + NOM.PL fathers)
h₁íns (masc. ACC.PL) resuming gʷṓs (fem.) looks like a gender mismatch; possible error

english: What is that? My mother lives far away, and (yet) she hears me. Do you shout to her? I do not shout. Is there a god in it? There is no god in it. I shout to my sister in the fields, and she hears me.
uncertain: HrewdH- read as 'shout, bellow' (Lat. rudo); could be 'weep, lament'
h₁ésmi read as LOC.SG of the anaphoric pronoun 'in it' (homographic with 'I am'); expected h₁ésmin?

english: You are a wolf: you have swallowed a meal. You are a sheep, you ate nothing, and you tremble. Eat, or the wolf will swallow you! I do not fear wolves. Now sit down and drink from my cup.
uncertain: second sentence may be 'You are not a sheep'; I read ne with kʷid 'nothing'
wĺ̥kʷoybʰos DAT/ABL.PL after 'fear', read as ablative

english: Shepherd, be well. Who are your gods? Father Sky stands above and Mother Earth lies below. Dawn, the daughter of Sky, brings the day. Whom do you praise? I do not praise the gods. Then may they not be angry with you!

Lord, be well. What is good for a man? Many horses, sons, and fame. A man of good fame gives to guests and praises the gods. When he dies, his fame is imperishable. What is good for you? My friends and songs. Now sing them to me.
uncertain: h₁yód read as conjunction 'when'; if relative 'who(ever)' it should be masc. h₁yós

english: Man, may you be well(-off)/good. Where do you live? I live in the village by the water. My grandmother is here, and at night she tells a story. Where is your grandfather? He died last year; now he lies below in the earth. Does your grandmother live? She lives, and she is dear to me.
uncertain: spéleh₂ as object of mléwHti looks NOM, expected ACC spéleh₂m; possible case error
